notes.title: Update January 9th, 2017
notes.content:
Today's update includes two large features and other small fixes. 
Firstly there's Vive Controller support. Now you can use your controllers to navigate Breakroom. Use the trigger to click, touchpad to right click, swipe with the touchpad to scroll and the grip button to find the virtual keyboard. 

The second feature is an experimental 360 video support. If you are playing a 360 video as a flat panorama in full screen mode, either on your browser or preferred video player, you can click the "Play 360 video" button that's on the menu on the bottom of each window. Then you can view the video as a 360 film. Press ESC to exit video mode and go back into Breakroom. 

Some minor fixes include reduced mouse jitter with head movement and increased performance in a couple of scenes.

notes.title: Update 0.10 - Curved Windows and Various Fixes
notes.content:
Today's update includes curved screens that increase the curvature when the applications are moved closer to the user. This feature can be removed in Preferences. 

The windows have better contrast and text readability.

Some aesthetic changes have been made to the windows as well. 

Performance has been improved dramatically. 

Various smaller bugfixes.
